chunks: And by this chain, it was said that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Two qualities in which many people are infatuated are health and leisure.'

key_terms.الْفَرَاغُ: Leisure, freedom from toil or work

ai.seo_question: What are the two qualities that cause people to be infatuated according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this concise prophetic saying highlighting that health and leisure are not merely physical states but spiritual tests, as their abundance often leads to heedlessness (ghaflah). This aligns with the Shia ethical tradition of viewing worldly ease as a potential trap that distracts from dhikr and worship, urging believers to utilize these blessings for spiritual growth rather than worldly indulgence. The term 'maftun' (infatuated) suggests a state of being captivated by the comfort itself, losing sight of the Divine purpose behind the gift.
